log.text: Lopunny used High Jump Kick → Weavile

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Aerodactyl-Mega. Lead Aerodactyl and Weavile: Fake Out the likely Tailwind or Mega-Lopunny threat while Rock Slide pressures Talonflame and Lopunny. Hatterene and Araquanid complete a resilient Trick Room backup, with Wide Guard protecting against spread attacks. Avoid Incineroar’s Intimidate into Defiant Kingambit.
decisions.notebook: Lopunny has Scrappy and repeatedly Protects under pressure; its Mega Triple Axel has missed and it was poor into Rock Slide plus Wide Guard. Mamoswine is Adamant Life Orb and has been used as a Gholdengo counter. Kingambit entered after Mamoswine fell, Protected under dual pressure, and used Sucker Punch on a fainted slot. Consider Hatterene + Araquanid Trick Room in future; account for Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant before Attack drops.

decisions.rationale: Intend Mega Lopunny. Lead Lopunny/Milotic uses Fake Out plus Icy Wind or Muddy Water to disrupt Mega Aerodactyl and avoid losing the speed race. Scrafty supplies a safer Gholdengo plan through Snarl, Knock Off, and Fake Out; Mamoswine adds immediate physical pressure and a strong endgame cleaner. Keep Milotic healthy as the durable Aerodactyl answer.

Mega Aero Crunch (Tough Claws 1.3x boost, ~156 effective power) on Lopunny, paired with Weavile priority Fake Out on Lopunny. Both attacks focus Lopunny, the biggest threat due to potential 4x SE HJK on Weavile. Fake Out priority +3 guarantees flinch before Lopunny can HJK. Crunch on single target keeps Weavile safe (Rock Slide would 2x SE Weavile and break Sash). Megas now for immediate Tough Claws pressure; non-Mega 200 Spe already outspeeds both foes and Mega range 187-222 still outspeed 170-
decisions.notebook: Lopunny Protects under pressure and may switch turn 1 (Mamoswine Adamant LO, Talonflame Sash likely switch-ins to absorb Fake Out). Crunch+Mega chunk Lopunny even through some defense. Save Wide Guard Araquanid + Hatterene Trick Room for later turns when Mamoswine/Kingambit/Scrafty come in. Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant punish Attack drops on physical Aero Crunch line. Mamoswine Adamant Life Orb is a hard Gholdengo counter per prior games.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Weavile prevents its attack if Lopunny wins the uncertain priority tie and avoids its Focus Sash issue. Icy Wind still provides speed control if Weavile moves first, while Mega Lopunny improves durability and preserves the guaranteed High Jump Kick threat next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's Mega Aerodactyl repeatedly pressures with Rock Slide and uses Protect to deny priority-based finishes. Gholdengo has revealed Make It Rain, Focus Blast, and Protect, making Kingambit an unreliable direct answer. Reassess Mega Lopunny fast-mode plans against this core; prioritize a durable Mega Aerodactyl answer and safer Gholdengo pressure. Talonflame plus Mamoswine lacked sufficient defensive or anti-Protect support.

decisions.rationale: Rock Slide hits both foes with Tough Claws boost and flinch chance; even if Lopunny Protects, Milotic takes damage. Knock Off on Milotic removes Leftovers, denying passive recovery chip. Both moves avoid wasting turns on a Protected target.
decisions.notebook: Lopunny Protects under pressure and may switch turn 1 (Mamoswine Adamant LO, Talonflame Sash likely switch-ins to absorb Fake Out). Crunch+Mega chunk Lopunny even through some defense. Save Wide Guard Araquanid + Hatterene Trick Room for later turns when Mamoswine/Kingambit/Scrafty come in. Scrafty Intimidate and Kingambit Defiant punish Attack drops on physical Aero Crunch line. Mamoswine Adamant Life Orb is a hard Gholdengo counter per prior games. Milotic runs Competitive + Leftovers - avoid stat-lowering moves. Aero/Weavile both lack SE on Milotic; pivot to Hatterene+Araquanid later for better matchup vs the slow fighters.

decisions.rationale: Araquanid is the safer replacement: Wide Guard can deny Milotic's Muddy Water and Icy Wind next turn, while its Water/Bug typing resists Lopunny's Fighting pressure. Hatterene is more exposed before it can establish Trick Room. Preserve Hatterene for a later protected Trick Room setup.
decisions.notebook: Lopunny Protects under pressure and may switch early; Mamoswine and Talonflame are plausible switch-ins. Crunch from Mega Aerodactyl dealt 24% to Mega Lopunny; Rock Slide dealt 17% despite resistance. Preserve Araquanid Wide Guard plus Hatterene Trick Room for the slow endgame, especially into Mamoswine/Kingambit/Scrafty. Avoid stat drops into Competitive Milotic. Milotic's spread speed control and Water damage strongly pressure Aerodactyl. Lopunny prioritizes removing Weavile with Fake Out into High Jump Kick.

decisions.rationale: High Jump Kick is guaranteed to KO Weavile before it acts. Muddy Water threatens a guaranteed KO on Aerodactyl if it does not Protect; if Aerodactyl Protects, Weavile still falls and the failed attack costs no Pokémon. Protecting Milotic leaves Aerodactyl active and gives up the best immediate double-removal line.
decisions.notebook: Mega Aerodactyl repeatedly pressures with Rock Slide and uses Protect to deny priority-based finishes. Favor durable answers that can pressure it without relying on priority. Gholdengo has Make It Rain, Focus Blast, and Protect; avoid treating Kingambit as a reliable direct answer. Talonflame plus Mamoswine lacked enough defensive or anti-Protect support.

decisions.rationale: Protect denies Milotic's spread KO and any Lopunny targeting into Aerodactyl, while Araquanid's Water Bubble-boosted Liquidation threatens Lopunny and strongly punishes likely Mamoswine or Talonflame switches. If Lopunny Protects, both key backline pieces remain intact for the Trick Room endgame.
decisions.notebook: Lopunny Protects under pressure and may switch early; Mamoswine and Talonflame are plausible switch-ins. Crunch from Mega Aerodactyl dealt 24% to Mega Lopunny; resisted Rock Slide dealt 17%. Preserve Araquanid Wide Guard plus Hatterene Trick Room for the slow endgame, especially into Mamoswine, Kingambit, or Scrafty. Avoid stat drops into Competitive Milotic. Milotic's spread speed control and Water damage strongly pressure Aerodactyl. Lopunny prioritized removing Weavile with Fake Out into High Jump Kick.

decisions.rationale: Triple Axel is super effective and can finish Aerodactyl without relying on priority; Wide Guard cannot stop it. Recover protects Milotic from Araquanid pressure and preserves the endgame. If Aerodactyl Protects, Lopunny avoids its attack next turn while Milotic heals; if it does not, Aerodactyl is removed.
decisions.notebook: Mega Aerodactyl repeatedly pressures with Rock Slide and may Protect to deny priority-based finishes. Prefer durable answers that pressure it without relying on priority. Gholdengo's Make It Rain, Focus Blast, and Protect are useful; do not treat Kingambit as a reliable direct answer. Talonflame plus Mamoswine lacked sufficient defensive or anti-Protect support.

decisions.rationale: Scrafty is the safer switch: Intimidate reduces both opposing physical threats and it avoids Mamoswine taking Araquanid’s super-effective Liquidation. Preserve Mamoswine for a later Ice Shard finish once Aerodactyl cannot safely Protect.
decisions.notebook: Mega Aerodactyl repeatedly uses Protect to deny priority finishes and pressures with Rock Slide. Preserve durable answers that can pressure it without relying solely on priority; Gholdengo remains a strong future mode with Make It Rain, Focus Blast, and Protect. Avoid treating Kingambit as a reliable direct answer. Talonflame plus Mamoswine lacked sufficient defensive or anti-Protect support.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl-Mega is at 1% HP and any hit kills it. Switching to Hatterene now saves a turn versus waiting for Aerodactyl to faint, accelerating Trick Room setup for the slow Araquanid endgame. Araquanid Wide Guard blocks Milotic's Muddy Water/Icy Wind (spread) and Scrafty's Snarl, protecting both the new switch-in and itself. Scrafty switched in turn 3, so on turn 4 Fake Out fails (second turn on field); Wide Guard is safe from priority flinch. Crunch into Milotic risks triggering Competitive; Cr
decisions.notebook: Lopunny-Mega fainted; opponent pivots to Scrafty + Milotic core. Crunch from Mega Aero only modest damage to bulky resists; Rock Slide into Milotic can miss. Scrafty has Roseli Berry, Intimidate, entered turn 3 (so Fake Out unavailable turn 4). Milotic has Competitive — never drop its stats, avoid stat-drop moves into it. Milotic Muddy Water and Icy Wind are spread; Wide Guard shuts them down. Crunch into Milotic occasionally drops Defense → Competitive trigger, never worth it. Wide Guard is the key support to preserve for Araquanid. Hatterene is the Trick Room setter; under TR Araquanid outspeeds Scrafty and Kingambit, ties/beats Mamoswine and Milotic. Plan: bring Hatterene in early, set Trick Room, Araquanid cleans with Water Bubble Liquidation. Remaining threats to scout: Mamoswine (Life Orb, Thick Fat), Talonflame (Gale Wings priority Brave Bird, Focus Sash), Kingambit (Defiant, Kowtow Cleave).

decisions.rationale: Fake Out denies Aerodactyl’s attack and KOs it if it does not Protect. Muddy Water also KOs the shown 1% target and pressures Araquanid despite spread reduction; it is preferable to Icy Wind for immediate damage, while Araquanid’s Liquidation is resisted by Milotic.

selection: Trick Room (all adjacent, including ally Araquanid)
decisions.rationale: Trick Room is the long-term win condition. Under TR, Araquanid (55) moves first vs Scrafty (78-110), Milotic (101-133), Mamoswine, and Kingambit — turning Araquanid into a Water Bubble sweeper. Liquidation chips Scrafty 28-49% so the next-turn TR-priority hit KOs. Hatterene absorbs ~50% from Knock Off+Muddy Water but Magic Bounce + Lum + 168 bulk let it survive. Wide Guard version keeps Hatterene safer but cedes tempo; Dazzling Gleam version KOs Scrafty but surrenders the TR sweep that wins the
decisions.notebook: Series p1 1-0. Mega Aero and Weavile dead; Lopunny dead. Core wincon: Hatterene TR + Araquanid Liquidation sweep under Water Bubble. Scrafty Fake Out exhausted turn 4, only Knock Off/Snarl/Protect left; Roseli Berry softens Dazzling Gleam but 4x SE still threatens. Milotic Competitive — never stat-drop. Crunch/Muddy Water chip is acceptable trade for TR setup. Wide Guard is the contingency when opponent spreads (Muddy Water, Icy Wind, Snarl). Remaining threats: Talonflame Gale Wings Brave Bird 2x SE on Araquanid (Talonflame is the only TR-resistant foe due to priority), Mamoswine Life Orb Thick Fat, Kingambit Defiant + Kowtow Cleave. Under TR, Araquanid outruns all three slow pokes; only Talonflame priority stays live. Plan: TR turn 5, sweep turns 6-9.

decisions.rationale: Knock Off acts before Hatterene and guarantees the KO from its shown HP, preventing Trick Room and Dazzling Gleam. Recover preserves Milotic through Araquanid’s likely Liquidation and avoids wasting a spread move into Wide Guard. This also retains Scrafty and Milotic as the endgame core.
decisions.notebook: Mega Aerodactyl repeatedly uses Protect to deny priority finishes and pressures with Rock Slide. Preserve durable answers that can pressure it without relying solely on priority. Gholdengo remains a strong future mode with Make It Rain, Focus Blast, and Protect. Avoid treating Kingambit as a reliable direct answer. Talonflame plus Mamoswine lacked sufficient defensive or anti-Protect support.

decisions.rationale: Dazzling Gleam 4x SE OHKOs Scrafty at 52% (Roseli halves Fairy but 4x still crushes), Liquidation OHKOs Milotic even at 0.5x (Water Bubble doubles + STAB + Mystic Water). Double sweep forces opponent to send 2 of {Talonflame, Mamoswine, Kingambit}. Talonflame Gale Wings is the only TR-resistant threat and won't appear till turn 7; Hatterene can handle it with Dazzling Gleam/Psychic while Araquanid sweeps Mamoswine/Kingambit under TR.
decisions.notebook: Series p1 1-0. Game 2: Mega Aero + Weavile sacrificed to remove Mega Lopunny and chip Milotic. Core wincon: Hatterene TR + Araquanid Water Bubble Liquidation sweep. Scrafty/Milotic fainted turn 6 (Dazzling Gleam + Liquidation). Remaining threats: Talonflame Gale Wings priority Brave Bird 2x SE on Araquanid (must OHKO before it moves — Hatterene Dazzling Gleam threatens it), Mamoswine Life Orb Icicle Crash neutral, Kingambit BlackGlasses Kowtow Cleave/ IronHead neutral (Defiant triggers off Intimidate chip — avoid dropping stats). Talonflame is TR-resistant; Mamoswine/Kingambit fall under TR. Plan turn 7+: Hatterene Dazzling Gleam Talonflame, Araquanid Liquidation Mamoswine or Kingambit. Keep Hatterene out of Sucker Punch range; preserve Araquanid above 50% to survive stray hits. Hatterene Lum Berry already consumed turn 4 (was for Snarl-induced SpD drop? actually no SpD drop occurred — likely chip damage). Wide Guard contingency only vs double spread when Araquanid can't OHKO both.

decisions.rationale: Trick Room makes Hatterene move first, and Dazzling Gleam is an immediate guaranteed KO on Scrafty, so Protect is mandatory. Milotic should use Muddy Water to pressure both foes and potentially finish Hatterene; Recover gives Hatterene another free turn and leaves the main threat active.

TR order: Hatterene(44)→Araquanid(55)→Scrafty(78-110)→Milotic(101-133). Hatterene Dazzling Gleam hits both (2x Fairy SE on Scrafty, neutral on Milotic); Araquanid Liquidation with Water Bubble+STAB finishes Scrafty. Scrafty at 52% faints before it can Knock Off. 25% miss on Dazzling Gleam (-1 acc) but EV is clearly positive. Leaves 2v1 vs Milotic with Araquanid Water Bubble advantage and 2 TR turns remaining.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Mega Aero + Weavile sacrificed turns 2-3 to remove Mega Lopunny. TR set turn 5, ~2 turns left after turn 7. Scrafty Intimidate chipped Araquanid atk. Lum Berry consumed turn 4. Remaining bench threats: Talonflame (FocusSash Gale Wings Brave Bird 2x SE on Araquanid — Hatterene Dazzling Gleam needed before Araquanid pivots in), Mamoswine (LifeOrb Icicle Crash/HighHorsepower, falls under TR), Kingambit (Defiant — avoid Intimidate chip on its switch-in). Plan turn 8+: handle Milotic, then pivot to threaten Talonflame with Hatterene Dazzling Gleam (Talonflame takes neutral, FocusSash activates, then Gale Wings chip). Wide Guard contingency vs double spread when Araquanid can't OHKO both. Hatterene stays fragile post-30% — preserve via Protect on key turns.

decisions.rationale: Both attacks target Hatterene, which is the immediate Dazzling Gleam threat and is in KO range. If it attacks, Scrafty removes it before Milotic moves; if it Protects, Muddy Water still pressures Araquanid unless Wide Guard blocks it, while Knock Off remains aimed at the key target. Preserve both Pokémon through the remaining Trick Room.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Protect is mandatory to preserve Hatterene at 4% from Mamoswine or a double target. Araquanid should Liquidate Mamoswine: it is super-effective, while both likely opposing attacks into Araquanid are resisted. This also keeps pressure on Mamoswine before Trick Room expires.
decisions.notebook: Opponent has repeatedly used Milotic Recover and spread attacks to stabilize, while Mamoswine is their current physical pressure under Trick Room. Preserve Hatterene when it can Protect safely; prioritize removing Mamoswine before pivoting toward the revealed Talonflame endgame. Avoid Intimidate against Kingambit because of Defiant.

decisions.rationale: Protect Mamoswine and Recover Milotic deny the strongest double-target sequence while Trick Room expires. Ice Shard is a guaranteed Hatterene KO, but is vulnerable to Hatterene Protect and leaves Araquanid free to KO Mamoswine; preserving both attackers gives the best next-turn position.

Talonflame plus Mamoswine lacked sufficient defensive or anti-Protect support. Opponent has repeatedly used Araquanid Wide Guard to block spread attacks; Hatterene's revealed mode is Trick Room plus Dazzling Gleam.

decisions.rationale: Araquanid Liquidation on Mamoswine is 4x effective (Water STAB + SE Ground + Water Bubble) and should OHKO, removing their physical pressure. Hatterene Dazzling Gleam spreads to both foes, pressuring Milotic which has been stabilizing with Recover. Hatterene at 4% HP is likely to die this turn regardless (Mamoswine Ice Shard priority threatens), so attacking maximizes value. Trick Room ends after this turn, so extending it doesn't help. Wide Guard is too situational. Psychic on Mamoswine wastes
decisions.notebook: Opponent's Mamoswine carries Life Orb + Thick Fat (confirmed). Milotic runs Leftovers + Competitive + Bold, repeatedly Recovers to stabilize. Opponent back pool: Talonflame (Focus Sash, Gale Wings, Jolly 160-195) and Kingambit (Black Glasses, Defiant, Adamant 70-102). Never Intimidate Kingambit. Milotic Muddy Water and Icy Wind are their primary spread pressure. Mamoswine is the TR-era physical wallbreaker. Water Bubble Araquanid Liquidation is the key KO tool against Ground-types.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Ice Shard priority reliably removes Hatterene before its action and does not depend on spread damage. Recover keeps Milotic healthy against Araquanid; Muddy Water risks Wide Guard and is less valuable than preserving the endgame. Trick Room then expires.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: 2v1 vs Milotic only. Aerodactyl at 1% dies to any hit; Milotic's only offense is spread (Muddy Water/Icy Wind), all blocked by Wide Guard. Araquanid +3 priority Wide Guard resolves before Milotic's 0-prio spread, so Aero is shielded. Crunch (neutral STAB + Tough Claws) then chunks Bold Milotic for solid damage, preserving Aero as a second attacker to finish next turn. Liquidation is 0.5x resisted and Araquanid is -1 Atk, so it cannot threaten a KO alone.
decisions.notebook: Milotic's only damaging moves are spread (Muddy Water, Icy Wind) plus Recover/Protect — no single-target option. Wide Guard cleanly shuts down her offense. Opponent back pool: Talonflame (Focus Sash, Gale Wings, Jolly 160-195) and Kingambit (Black Glasses, Defiant, Adamant 70-102) — neither brought. Confirmed: opponent's Mamoswine = Life Orb + Thick Fat; Milotic = Leftovers + Competitive + Bold (Competitive means don't stack stat drops on it). Water Bubble Araquanid Liquidation is the key Ground-type KO tool. For future games: lead matchup favors my TR+Hatterene+Scrafty shell vs their TR sweepers, but Mamoswine + Milotic core checks both water and ground answers; consider Talonflame lead for Tailwind vs their slower back.

decisions.rationale: Milotic is at full HP and Aerodactyl is likely to Protect against the spread KO. Recover safely denies the main double-target line while Araquanid's Liquidation is resisted, preserving the guaranteed follow-up to remove Aerodactyl.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl at 1% HP must either OHKO Milotic or accept death. Crunch at 222 Speed outsprints Milotic (101-133); if Crunch KOs, Milotic never fires Muddy Water. Wide Guard on Araquanid covers the case Crunch doesn't OHKO—blocks Muddy Water/Icy Wind spread, and Araquanid survives to Liquidation next turn. Best risk-adjusted line: secure the KO attempt and have insurance.
decisions.notebook: Aerodactyl-Mega at 1% HP is expendable—commit to KO attempts. Milotic = Bold + Leftovers + Competitive; Wide Guard hard-counters its only offense (Muddy Water, Icy Wind spread). Crunch Tough Claws boosted, neutral on Water—likely 2HKO range, not guaranteed OHKO. Araquanid Liquidation resisted 0.5x but Water Bubble 2x→effective neutral; with -1 Atk still chunks. Opponent back pool: Talonflame (Gale Wings Sash) + Kingambit (Defiant Adamant)—neither brought this game. For game 3 plans: avoid letting Milotic stockpile Competitive boosts; pair Water Bubble Araquanid with Wide Guard support against Milotic. Mamoswine = Life Orb + Thick Fat confirmed. TR Hatterene+Scrafty shell favored matchup but Mamoswine+Milotic core checks both. Consider Talonflame lead for Tailwind in future.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine is fainted, so slot 1 must pass. Protect is safest against Aerodactyl's likely attack and Araquanid's resisted Liquidation; Milotic can preserve its boosted Special Attack and full health for the next turn. Muddy Water is the strongest punish if Aerodactyl does not Protect or Araquanid does not Wide Guard, but passing now avoids risking the only remaining Pokémon.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Milotic cannot Protect this turn (reduced success rate after last turn), so it will attack with Muddy Water or Icy Wind—both spread and SE on Aero at 1% HP. Wide Guard blocks these, keeping Aero alive for another turn of damage. Crunch deals solid Tough Claws-boosted neutral damage to Milotic. This is a free attack window since Milotic is locked out of Protect.
decisions.notebook: Milotic Protect success rate reduced after first use—free attack window. Wide Guard hard-counters Milotic's only offense (Muddy Water, Icy Wind spread). Crunch Tough Claws neutral on Water, 2HKO range not guaranteed OHKO. Araquanid Liquidation 0.5x resisted but Water Bubble 2x→neutral effective; -1 Atk still chunks. Opponent Mamoswine+Milotic core checks TR Hatterene+Scrafty shell. Mamoswine = Life Orb + Thick Fat confirmed. Opponent back pool: Talonflame (Gale Wings Sash) + Kingambit (Defiant Adamant)—neither brought. For game 3: Talonflame lead for Tailwind, or reconsider TR shell vs Mamoswine+Milotic core. Avoid letting Milotic stockpile Competitive boosts—pair Water Bubble Araquanid with Wide Guard support.

decisions.rationale: Icy Wind is the best immediate line: Aerodactyl is at 1% and is super-effective-targeted, while Icy Wind is more accurate than Muddy Water and also lowers Araquanid's Speed if Wide Guard is not used. Recover concedes another turn to Aerodactyl's pressure.
decisions.notebook: Opponent repeatedly favors Araquanid Wide Guard alongside Mega Aerodactyl Protect or direct Rock/Dark pressure. Preserve non-priority ways to pressure Mega Aerodactyl and avoid relying on spread damage alone.

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl at 1% HP is dead regardless—sacrifice it for double damage. Crunch+Liquidation puts Milotic in Araquanid solo range (~34-39%) where Araquanid can finish in 3-4 hits before Milotic's 3 remaining Recovers stall it out. Wide Guard would let Milotic Recover to ~100% and force a 7-8 turn grind. The 1/3 Protect risk is acceptable: even if blocked, we still have Araquanid at 80% to grind it out.
decisions.notebook: Milotic Protect success rate reduced after first use—free attack window. Wide Guard hard-counters Milotic's only offense (Muddy Water, Icy Wind spread). Crunch Tough Claws neutral on Water, 2HKO range not guaranteed OHKO. Araquanid Liquidation 0.5x resisted but Water Bubble 2x→neutral effective; -1 Atk still chunks ~10-11%. Opponent Mamoswine+Milotic core checks TR Hatterene+Scrafty shell. Mamoswine = Life Orb + Thick Fat confirmed. Opponent back pool: Talonflame (Gale Wings Sash) + Kingambit (Defiant Adamant)—neither brought. For game 3: Talonflame lead for Tailwind, or reconsider TR shell vs Mamoswine+Milotic core. Avoid letting Milotic stockpile Competitive boosts—pair Water Bubble Araquanid with Wide Guard support. Milotic has 3 Recover PP left—key resource to exhaust.

decisions.rationale: Muddy Water and Icy Wind are repeatedly stopped by Wide Guard, while Milotic must preserve its only endgame presence. Recover restores damage from Crunch or Liquidation and keeps it healthy for the next opening to remove Aerodactyl.
decisions.notebook: Opponent repeatedly prioritizes Araquanid Wide Guard beside Mega Aerodactyl, often enabling direct Crunch pressure. Do not rely on spread damage alone; preserve single-Pokémon durability and seek openings after Wide Guard or Protect timing.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl Crunch into Milotic: tool shows 53-63% at neutral; Milotic has -1 Def from prior Crunch, pushing effective damage to ~79-94% which guarantees KO from 58% HP. Aerodactyl outspeeds Milotic 222 vs 101-133, so Milotic cannot Recover before being hit. Araquanid Wide Guard provides insurance: if Milotic Protects (cooldown clear) and Crunch fails, Wide Guard blocks Muddy Water (2x SE on Aero) and Icy Wind. If Crunch KOs, Wide Guard is wasted but harmless. This secures the KO and protects the
decisions.notebook: Milotic Protect cooldown: used turn 11, clear by turn 14. Milotic has 3 Recover PP left—key resource to exhaust. Crunch Tough Claws neutral on Water, with -1 Def boost guarantees KO from ~58% range. Araquanid Liquidation 0.5x resisted but Water Bubble 2x→neutral effective, ~10-11% per hit. Wide Guard hard-counters Milotic's only offense (Muddy Water, Icy Wind spread). Opponent back pool: Talonflame (Gale Wings Sash) + Kingambit (Defiant Adamant)—neither brought game 2. For game 3: Talonflame lead for Tailwind vs Mamoswine+Milotic core, or reconsider TR shell. Avoid letting Milotic stockpile Competitive boosts—pair Water Bubble Araquanid with Wide Guard support.

decisions.rationale: Recover best preserves Milotic through the likely Crunch plus Liquidation line and maintains the only remaining win condition. Protect is safer for one turn but forfeits healing momentum; spread attacks are vulnerable to the opponent's repeatedly demonstrated Wide Guard and may miss.
decisions.notebook: Opponent strongly favors Araquanid Wide Guard beside Mega Aerodactyl, often pairing it with direct Crunch pressure. Preserve single-target durability and avoid relying on spread damage alone; attack after Wide Guard or Protect timing when possible.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl at 1% HP dies to any spread hit—Wide Guard blocks Muddy Water (2x SE) and Icy Wind (both spread). Crunch chips Milotic while Wide Guard stalls. Milotic has 3 Recover PP left; after exhausting, Crunch + Wide Guard guarantees KO since Wide Guard blocks all spread and Milotic forces attacks.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0 lead, game 2. Milotic runs out of Recover after 3 more uses—then Crunch + Wide Guard guarantees KO. Crunch vs Milotic at -1 Def with Tough Claws: ~18-35% range. Wide Guard mandatory against Milotic's spread offense. Game 3 plan: lead Talonflame for Tailwind vs Milotic+Mamoswine core, or reconsider TR shell. Dampen Milotic Competitive synergy by avoiding -Def stacks paired with Water Bubble Araquanid. Avoid leading Hatterene turn 1 vs Mamoswine if TR not up—Ice Shard priority KO risk. Crunch into Milotic at -1 Def is set up for guaranteed KO from ~58% HP—pressure threshold to remember.

decisions.rationale: Milotic is the only Pokémon able to act. Protect avoids Aerodactyl's lethal Crunch while scouting whether Araquanid continues Wide Guard. Spread attacks are likely blocked, and Recover risks being overwhelmed by Crunch plus Liquidation.
decisions.notebook: Opponent strongly favors Araquanid Wide Guard beside Mega Aerodactyl and uses direct Crunch pressure. Preserve single-target durability; do not rely on spread attacks alone, and attack after Wide Guard or Protect timing when possible.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Aerodactyl-Mega)
decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl moves first (222 vs 101-133). Crunch into Milotic at -1 Def deals 18-42%—best single-target option, edges Earthquake due to 0.75x spread reduction. Wide Guard mandatory: Muddy Water/Icy Wind at +2 SpA 2x SE would OHKO Aerodactyl at 1% HP. Wide Guard also blocks Araquanid if I had used Earthquake. Stalls out Milotic's last Recover PP for guaranteed Crunch KO.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-0 lead, game 2 in progress. Milotic alone (Mamoswine/Lopunny/Scrafty fainted; Talonflame/Kingambit not brought). Aerodactyl-Mega at 1% HP—Wide Guard mandatory every turn it survives. Crunch at -1 Def confirmed 18-42% to Milotic, Earthquake worse due to 0.75x spread reduction. reflections.summary: Won by pressuring Milotic with Crunch chip + Araquanid Liquidation while using Wide Guard to neutralize Muddy Water/Icy Wind. Milotic's Competitive and Recover could not offset steady -2 Def Crunch damage after Araquanid softened it; final double brought Milotic to 11% then KO'd. The Mega (Aerodactyl) was a clean pick into this bulky Water-heavy back, but came out only after taking a Muddy Water on the final turn—Wide Guard usage was the key to keeping it alive through mid-game.
reflections.adjustment: Lead with a clearer win condition next game: don't let Milotic stall on Protect/Recover. Either commit a second Crunch user (Weavile Knock Off into Talonflame/Kingambit if brought) to strip recovery support, or switch the Crunch user to Earthquake to threaten Mamoswine/Scrafty leads that swap in. If Milotic is a known threat, plan an end-game with Araquanid Liquidation + a faster cleaner, not a solo Crunch 1v1.
reflections.notebook: Game 2 confirmations: Milotic build = Bold, Leftovers, Competitive, Recover/Protect/Icy Wind/Muddy Water. Crunch -1 Def into Milotic ≈ 50% from full; -2 Def ≈ 75%. Wide Guard reliably blocks Muddy Water and Icy Wind from Milotic, making the Water matchup winnable on offense. Opponent core (Milotic/Mamoswine/Lopunny/Scrafty) loses to Rock Slide and Crunch chip, but Milotic is a hard neutral answer if it can Recover freely. Talonflame and Kingambit are the likely game 3 bring; expect Talonflame Tailwind or Taunt support and Kingambit Kowtow/Sucker Punch pivot. Plan: avoid Hatterene solo lead into Mamoswine; prefer Weavile Fake Out pressure or Aerodactyl Rock Slide lead to scout and punish. If Milotic appears, double Crunch + Wide Guard remains the proven plan, but bring a backup answer to Lopunny/Scrafty Fake Out speed control. Series secured 2-0; no further notes on momentum needed.
